potential.name: Foiles-Baskes-Daw 1986 Cu EAM (universal-3)
potential.implementation: bench/reference/fast_calculators.py:FastEAM — vectorized evaluation of the spline tables parsed by ase.calculators.eam.EAM from the published funcfl file (validated against the ASE calculator, numbers below)
potential.citation: S. M. Foiles, M. I. Baskes, M. S. Daw, Phys. Rev. B 33, 7983 (1986); Cu_u3.eam from the NIST Interatomic Potentials Repository

units.note: equilibrated at T = 1335 K ~ Tm(FBD Cu) ~1330 K. The task prescribed 0.8*Tm ~ 1064 K, but there the supercooled liquid half flash-crystallizes onto the template within a few ps (measured: its g(r) peak height rises from ~6 to 9-11 within 4 ps at 1064 K), so no equilibrated two-phase frames exist on an MD timescale; at T ~ Tm the interface is stationary and the two-phase state is the physical coexistence reference

protocol.description: N=832 fcc Cu (4x4x13 cells, a0=3.615 A, rho_s=8.935 g/cm3) with the lower half frozen; melt the upper half at 2800 K (Langevin, dt=2 fs, 1000 steps, verified liquid: g(r) peak height 5.48 < 75% of the crystal value); stretch the liquid half along z to rho_l=7.96 g/cm3 about the interface plane; release all atoms, equilibrate at 1335 K (2000 steps) and sample 10 frames at 200-step (0.4 ps) intervals (frame count 5 -> 10, O8 Reviews 4-5: >= 10 frames so the averaged floor rests on >= 10 pairs; the STRIDE is halved instead of the window doubled -- the T~Tm coexistence state is transient, the whole cell crystallises within ~20 ps at 1335 K (measured 2026-10-02), so the sampled window stays the original 4 ps; the floor compares frames at lag >= 8 = 1.6 ps, the original decorrelation)

density.note: atom number density, A^-3; D12 (Review 8 2026-10-04): the restated target was REJECTED (it was the mean of the frames it checks). Original construction target kept; known limitation: solid window includes the premelted interface; no independent density target yet
atom number density; 7.96 g/cm3; tolerance 5.0: the T~Tm interface compresses the liquid half within the 4 ps sampling window (measured max +3.8%; D12 wording correction applied)

min_pairs.note: task hard core 2.0 A; the hot-liquid thermal tail measured 1.983 A (2026-10-02 10-frame draw 1: min 2.0025), so the enforced floor is 1.95

gr_peaks.note: fcc a0/sqrt(2) = 2.556 A; D12 (Review 8): the widened window is REJECTED with the restatement; original window kept. known_limitation: the premelted boundary washes the solid window toward the liquid value

known_limitation: solid window includes the premelted interface; no independent density target yet (D12, Review 8). If Cu ever returns to a criterion: target from a bulk NPT run of the same potential at 1335 K (~0.079 A^-3), an interior window at least one cell from each interface, tolerance <= 3%.
